facts.text: La Residencia is a mountainside hotel in Deia, Mallorca.
facts.excerpt: Inspiration meets relaxation at our mountainside hideaway in Deià, Mallorca.

facts.text: The twin manor houses at the core of the estate date back to the 17th century and were once the home of Cistercian monks.
facts.excerpt: Dating back to the 17th century, the twin manor houses at the core of the estate were once the home of Cistercian monks.

facts.text: The property opened as a hotel in 1984.
facts.excerpt: Opening as a hotel in 1984, it was the first of its kind

facts.text: The hotel has the Sa Tafona art gallery, an art studio and a sculpture studio with a resident artist.
facts.excerpt: Sa Tafona art gallery, art studio and sculpture studio with resident artist

facts.text: Dining is at El Olivo, Restaurante Miro and Tramuntana Grill.
facts.excerpt: Refined Mallorcan cuisine at El Olivo, Restaurante Miró and Tramuntana Grill

facts.text: El Olivo serves fine dining Mediterranean cuisine.
facts.excerpt: Fine dining Mediterranean cuisine at El Olivo

facts.text: Tramuntana Grill serves grilled specialties and seafood by the pool.
facts.excerpt: Tramuntana Grill for grilled specialties and seafood by our iconic pool

facts.text: The hotel has indoor and outdoor swimming pools.
The hotel has a spa, a gym and tennis courts.
The hotel has a kids club.
Named accommodation includes the Matthew Williamson Suite, the Miro Suite, the Sheridan Suite and the secluded Villa Robert Graves.
facts.excerpt: Relish in the exuberant Matthew Williamson Suite, find relaxation in the Miró or Sheridan Suite, or seize the key to the secluded Villa Robert Graves

facts.text: The hotel is a 45 minute drive from Palma Airport.
Soller is a 20 minute drive from the hotel.
